card.name: Partway through long names
card.fires_on: The pole responds to a piece in the middle of a longer word that is still unfinished, most often the 'ib' in kinase-inhibitor drug names such as ruxolitinib. It also fires inside place names, personal names and long medical words.

modes.label: Drug names ending in -tinib
modes.description: The 'ib' piece completes a kinase-inhibitor name just before a verb or noun follows.
modes.example: Ruxolitin<<ib>> is known to be a substrate for cy

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: A middle piece of a proper name, foreign word or long medical or capitalized word.
modes.example: In 1559 the grand duke of T<<usc>>any, Cosimo I de’ Med

card.writes: The promoted tokens are scattered word pieces and mixed-language items, and the suppressed tokens are common small words and punctuation, so it favors continuing the word rather than starting a new one.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a long drug, place or person name that is not finished yet.
